title: Digital Workforce sits on both Flowable's partner and OEM pages, part vendor part provider
content:
Digital Workforce appears in both the Flowable Partner Finder and Flowable's OEM page, and the record reads that duality literally: part vendor, part service provider. The firm is also Nasdaq First North listed, so its commitments are public-market commitments.

The dual listing is the substantive finding because the two roles imply opposite behaviour toward a third-party layer. A service provider assembles what the client needs and can add a record layer to a delivery; an OEM embeds the engine inside its own product and sells the result under its own brand, where an external component is either something to license and resell or something that competes with its packaging. Which of the two applies decides whether the conversation is partnership or channel licensing.

So this is a qualification gap rather than a verdict, which is consistent with the priority 3 filing. The next step is to establish which side of the business would own the relationship. Provenance is the Flowable Partner Finder mined on 2026-08-18, and the row has not been imprint-swept.
